repository.name: agid-postal-kh
repository.purpose: Cambodia postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.code_name: MPTC Prakas No. 77 six-digit postal code
postal_system.assignment_rule: MPTC Prakas No. 77 was signed and effective on 30 December 2025. Its 59 pages explicitly assign PP0000 to province/capital postal areas, PPDD00 to municipality/district/khan postal areas, and PPDDCC to commune/sangkat postal areas. Production assignment requires the exact current typed MPTC artifact or a verified transformation with source version, row identity, Khmer and Latin names, jurisdiction, validity, retrieval time, schema, rights and digest pinned. A format match, prefix, NCDD code, UPU example, Cambodia Post page, ODC row, coordinate, model or third-party map alone does not create a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Prakas No. 77 names postal areas but supplies no coordinate geometry. Do not relabel an NCDD administrative boundary as official MPTC postal geometry merely because PP, DD or CC digits and names match. An administrative crosswalk may produce a derived validation surface only when typed identities, source dates, jurisdiction and topology are reviewed. Official point, polygon or multipolygon requires an exact MPTC or competent-authority artifact explicitly relating the typed postal code to the geometry and pinning validity, CRS, licence and digest. Voronoi, interpolation, address points, routes, OSM, machine learning and real-time generation stay derived and never fill unknown official coverage.
postal_system.address_format_rule: The UPU sheet dated 11/2018 documents six digits to the right of locality or province and urban and rural elements including addressee, premises, street and sub-locality, plus province, municipality, district or khan, commune or sangkat. Prakas No. 77 controls current assignments. Dated examples and formatted strings are parsing/display semantics, not reusable addresses, geometry, building identity, resident identity or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.administrative_rule: The NCDD Gazetteer lists Khmer and Latin names, codes, legal references and GIS through province, municipality/district/khan, commune/sangkat and village. Its administrative identities and boundaries remain independent objects. Code equality, name equality, containment, a village parent or temporal overlap can support a versioned derived postal crosswalk but cannot prove official postal boundary equality or building membership.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic address identity, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building point or footprint geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, commune, village, geocode, parcel, coordinate, OSM footprint, containment or proximity is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: MLMUPC electronic cadastral information, parcel, map-copy, orthophoto, survey, construction and related services are request-, account- or fee-mediated. Portal visibility and a parcel or construction record do not create an open national civic-address/building corpus, postal geometry, owner/occupant publication right or delivery relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: APIs, cached observations and mathematical or machine-learning models may improve search, detect gaps, create compact derived candidate surfaces and prioritize review. Every output must preserve model and feature version, input digests, observed_at, generated_at, confidence, uncertainty, cache TTL and derived status. It can never overwrite a current MPTC assignment, manufacture official geometry, infer a house number or building, or silently turn absence into coverage.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Typed postcodes, permitted address points, reviewed derived surfaces and explicitly linked buildings may connect to AGID cells only through versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postal area, administrative unit, civic address, parcel or building as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is official MPTC geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The MPTC PDF and UPU sheet are reference sources unless exact reuse rights are established. NCDD and MLMUPC require exact artifact and service terms. ODC-published transformed tables state CC BY-SA 4.0 but the exact source PDF, transformation, attribution and share-alike obligations must be pinned. ODbL data remains separate. Pin every resource, terms version, attribution, access rule, override and digest before promotion.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact civic addresses, coordinates, entrances, floors, units, rooms, recipients, residents, owners, occupants, parcel rights, construction records, accounts, API keys and query logs may expose household, property, security or personal context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Prakas assignments, historical assignments, administrative units, names, boundaries, addresses, parcels, buildings, service responses and crosswalks are time-dependent. Store object_type, valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version and supersession independently; never silently rewrite historical evidence or promote cached responses or model output into timeless facts.

stages.definition: A current rights-cleared typed Prakas 77 assignment release, complete for its declared jurisdiction, level and time scope, retains six-digit strings, Khmer/Latin names, source row identity, edition, validity and exact artifact digests. Require reproducible full-row reconciliation against the primary legal artifact, independently licensed point/area geometry, CRS/topology validation, administrative crosswalk review, civic-address/building-link review and privacy/licence/provenance review. Publish approved immutable data artifacts and verify the actual AGID loader/API. Administrative code equality does not prove postal identity or official boundary equality; derived/virtual/none stay explicit, do not replace the required licensed geometry and cannot infer premises or buildings.
